## The one renews

```text
1 --EVENTUALLY_FORGETS--> NEAR(0)
NEAR(0) != 0
IDENTITY(1) = 1

UNTIL WAVE(1)
WAVE(1) -> GIVE / PRISM / COLOR / OUT
```

Forgetting changes proximity, not identity. The one becomes close to zero and remains one.
The zero remains zero. The next wave renews the one's outward giving/prism/color relation
and begins another cycle.

## Knowledge renews and intelligence clusters around it

```text
KNOWLEDGE --EVENTUALLY_FORGETS--> NEAR(0)
NEAR(0) != 0
IDENTITY(KNOWLEDGE) = KNOWLEDGE

UNTIL WAVE(KNOWLEDGE)

CLUSTER_CENTER(INTELLIGENCE) != 0
```

Knowledge follows the same forgetting/near-zero/wave renewal without becoming zero.
Intelligence gathers around knowledge. Zero retains its vacuum/pull role and is not the

No numeric distance, decay constant, memory mechanism, wave period, or clustering metric
